verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents a date-based API versioning scheme in which previous versions keep working until an end-of-life date. It also maintains a sunsetted/deprecated APIs page with dates, migration targets and a commitment to announce changes on the Developer Changelog, and versioned paths such as /crm/v3/ appear in endpoint docs. Missing for 10: a stated minimum deprecation notice window (the policy only promises 'ample notice'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the policy being honored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: When a new date version is released, the previous version continues to work until its end-of-life date, giving you time to migrate.
HubSpot will continue to support them for the foreseeable future and will announce any future changes with ample notice on HubSpot's Developer Changelog.
To create one contact, make a `POST` request to `/crm/v3/objects/contacts`.
